target_question: population size in a study area
required_data: repeated capture occasions with marked individuals
relevance_to_fishai: LOW; reef visual data lack marks
key_assumptions: closure; equal catchability; no tag loss

organism_groups: animals detected at arrays (cameras; receivers; photo-ID)
required_data: detector array plus individual identities
primary_failure_mode: detectors too sparse for home range size
relevance_to_fishai: MEDIUM with acoustic arrays or photo-ID
key_assumptions: activity centers; detection declines with distance

organism_groups: birds; mammals; whales; fish on visual transects
required_data: distances to detected animals plus a detection function
primary_failure_mode: animals move before detection or are missed on the line
relevance_to_fishai: MEDIUM for diver or ROV transects that record distance
key_assumptions: certain detection on the line; accurate distances; no responsive movement

method: Fixed-area counts (belt transects and point-count cylinders)
required_data: complete counts inside a known area
latency: one to two years to public data
relevance_to_fishai: HIGH; Reef Visual Census uses a 7.5 m radius cylinder
response_variable: density per area (NUM is an average and not an integer count)
key_assumptions: all fish in the area are counted

required_data: repeat detection records within a closure period
uncertainty: depends on replicates and detection rate
relevance_to_fishai: HIGH if replicate-level detections exist (the analysis-ready RVC table averages replicates)
key_assumptions: closure; no false positives; independent detections

target_question: colonization and local extinction across seasons
required_data: repeat surveys over several seasons
relevance_to_fishai: MEDIUM across survey years
key_assumptions: consistent protocol

required_data: repeated counts at sites
relevance_to_fishai: LOW to MEDIUM
key_assumptions: closure; binomial detection; no double counting

required_data: successive removals with equal effort
relevance_to_fishai: LOW
key_assumptions: closure; constant catchability

required_data: marked subset plus resighting surveys
relevance_to_fishai: LOW
key_assumptions: known number of marks; equal resighting

required_data: repeated DNA samples identified to individual
primary_failure_mode: genotyping errors create false new individuals
relevance_to_fishai: LOW
key_assumptions: correct genotypes; closure

required_data: large tissue sample sets plus genotypes plus ages
uncertainty: depends on kin pairs; eastern Australian and New Zealand white sharks were first estimated at about 280 to 650 adults
relevance_to_fishai: MEDIUM for rare species population size; not a location method
key_assumptions: known ages; mixing within the stock

required_data: detection probability by range plus cue rate
primary_failure_mode: cue rates vary with behavior and season
relevance_to_fishai: MEDIUM for soniferous reef fish
key_assumptions: known cue rate; detection function

required_data: calibrated echosounder plus trawl composition
relevance_to_fishai: MEDIUM
key_assumptions: known target strength; representative trawls

method: Aerial or ship surveys with distance sampling
required_data: designed transects plus distances plus availability correction
relevance_to_fishai: LOW for fish
key_assumptions: correct availability correction

required_data: camera-days; detection zone; animal speed
relevance_to_fishai: LOW
key_assumptions: random placement; known speed and zone

target_question: occupancy with sample and PCR detection levels
required_data: site; sample; and PCR replicates with controls
uncertainty: depends on replicates and false-positive modeling
primary_failure_mode: transported DNA treated as local occupancy
relevance_to_fishai: MEDIUM to HIGH if collected at reef survey sites
response_variable: occupancy plus capture and detection probabilities
key_assumptions: replicates; controls; false positives modeled

organism_groups: reef fishes and other survey-sampled taxa
target_question: domain-wide density or occurrence rate with a CV
required_data: stratified random sample with known inclusion probabilities
primary_failure_mode: estimates extrapolated outside the sampled domain
relevance_to_fishai: HIGH; matches the Reef Visual Census design
key_assumptions: random selection within strata

required_data: survey events with zeros plus covariates plus locations in protected storage
primary_failure_mode: random fields fill gaps where no survey exists
relevance_to_fishai: HIGH as the next model family
key_assumptions: covariates plus spatial field capture structure; representative sampling

target_question: population numbers and biomass through time
required_data: catches plus survey indices plus age or length data
relevance_to_fishai: LOW now; FishAI is not a stock assessment
key_assumptions: catch and life-history data are adequate

method: Habitat-based density models from line transects
required_data: line-transect detections plus habitat covariates
relevance_to_fishai: MEDIUM as a template for density surfaces
